name: Brian Shaw
why: His own senior class studio portrait; the only other frame of him is the back row of a 39-person ASG group photograph.
caption_quote: BRIAN SHAW, civil engin. tech., Henderson

src.label: 1983 Talisman, p. 351, senior portraits (Sha-Smi). The names run in blocks of five down the right-hand column and each block is one row of five portraits, left to right; Shaw is third of five in the first block and third in the top row. The rows line up: positions 1, 4 and 5 are the women Cynthia A. Shaver, Carol A. Sheets and Deborah N. Shelton, positions 2 and 3 the men Richard K. Shaver and Shaw. The volume's index reads "Shaw, Brian Douglas 232, 233, 258, 351", and p. 232 is the Associated Student Government group photograph whose back row names Brian Shaw, so the face on 351 is the ASG parliamentarian and not a namesake.

name: Julie Fleming
why: Cropped from the Associated Student Government group photograph of her own year; she has no class portrait in any volume, so this is the only frame of her the archive holds.
caption_quote: Front Row: Joe E. Rains, Emily G. Morgan, Julie M. Fleming, Van C. Hodge, Jr.

src.label: 1990 Talisman, p. 162, Associated Student Government group photograph. The caption gives three rows, four names in the front and five in each of the middle and back, and the photograph shows exactly that: four figures in front, five behind them and five standing at the back. Counting the front row left to right, Fleming is third of four. The row is confirmed independently by its fourth figure, Van C. Hodge Jr., whose separate class portrait on p. 114 of the same volume is the same man, and by Gregory L. Willoughby, second in the back row and the man in glasses whose class portrait is on p. 129.
